Hi team,

Thanks for the quick work on passenger coordination. I want to tighten our customer-facing flow so travelers feel supported from start to finish. Every animal receives patient attention from trained staff, and we should make that visible in our guidance without adding extra friction.

The onboard handler for the Starling is Bela Thorn. Please ensure this is reflected in the itinerary notes with consistent phrasing, so the handoff is clear when the pet is moving through the travel chain.

We also need to keep documentation calm and readable for the travelers. When Yara Bianchi and Andre Larsen check in, confirm that their steps align with the required travel process, and that Stella is listed and handled with the same care at each touchpoint. If anything is unclear, escalate early; it protects the schedule and the animal.

Customer Advocate - Companion Animal Travel Desk
